form.sells:
Chop & Fly is a food and catering business based in Ibadan, Nigeria. We specialise in freshly prepared, delicious and affordable meals, including pasta dishes and customised food packages for individuals, groups and events.

Our services include online food orders, event catering, corporate catering and bulk meal supply. We cater to different occasions, guest sizes and budgets, with a focus on food quality, generous portions, excellent customer service and timely delivery.

We want to build a scalable food brand that combines everyday meal services with professional event catering.
form.address: Plot 10-11, Ishola Abiona close, Akinpade layout, Akobo, Ibadan
form.terms: A 70% deposit is required to confirm the booking. Any changes to the agreed menu, guest count or service requirements may attract additional charges.
